The Grand Strategist: logo exploration

Five icons, five wordmarks and three lockups. Every file is a hand-built SVG with text converted to outlines. Each is shown on light and dark, at large size, 32px and 16px, and in one flat colour (navy, white, black). Nothing here is applied to the app.

Final choice: icon-02 Apex + wordmark-03 Two-tier

Chosen 15 Nov. The exploration below is kept for the record. Final files: lockups/lockup-01-*.svg, lockups/lockup-01-compact-*.svg and ../favicon/.

Full lockup

Compact, for 375px headers

Favicon set

Heavier-stroke cut of the Apex so it holds at 16px. favicon.svg follows the browser theme; the PNGs sit on navy.

Palette

Burnished Gold is for navy backgrounds and large graphics only. On light backgrounds, gold text and borders use Deep Gold, and gold inside the logo uses Mark Gold.

Lockups

Icon and wordmark side by side, as they would sit in the site header. lockup-01 and lockup-01-compact are final.

lockup-01 · icon-02 + wordmark-03

FINAL. Apex + Two-tier: icon about as tall as the two text tiers, wide gap. The gold node and the gold THE carry the same idea.

32px · 16px tall
One colour white, 32px · 16px

lockup-02 · icon-01 + wordmark-02

Bearing G + Spaced caps: the modern pairing, cleanest in a narrow header.

32px · 16px tall
One colour white, 32px · 16px

lockup-03 · icon-02 + wordmark-01

Apex + Editorial serif: the warmer, more literary pairing.

32px · 16px tall
One colour white, 32px · 16px

lockup-01-stacked · icon-02 + wordmark-03 (two lines)

FINAL, stacked. Apex + GRAND over STRATEGIST, for the narrowest phone headers (320px).
